lead.en: Host-driven inline completion in an editable text field.
lead.zh: 由宿主提供文字续写建议，显示在真实输入光标后。

rule.en: The host owns suggestion requests. Abort on Cancel and return chunks with their Request ID; old or composing responses are ignored. The example is simulated.
rule.zh: 宿主负责建议请求；收到 Cancel 时中止，并使用 Request 中的编号返回分段结果。旧请求或输入法组合中的结果会被忽略。预览为模拟数据。

api.en: Tab accepts all; Cmd/Ctrl/Alt+Right accepts a word; Escape dismisses. The action chip accepts on touch. Selection and IME composition suppress suggestions.
api.zh: Tab 接受全部建议；Cmd/Ctrl/Alt 加右方向键逐词接受；Esc 取消；触屏可点按钮接受。选择文本或输入法组合时不会显示建议。

motion.en: The current implementation places text without a fade; polished transitions and native IME/touch testing remain pending.
motion.zh: 当前建议文字直接显示，淡入动效及真实输入法和触屏验收仍待完成。
